children: Chile's economic activity declined 1.5% in July when compared to a year earlier, central bank data showed on Tuesday, missing market forecasts as economists polled by Reuters expected a 0.4% year-on-year expansion.
On a monthly basis, the IMACEC index - which accounts for about 90% of the Andean country's gross domestic product - registered a 1.7% decrease, the central bank added.
